name: Yuzuki no Makashikata ~Kyou kara Oji-san no Koto, "Omae" tte Yobu ne♪~
original_name: 結月の負かし方～今日からおじさんのこと、「お前」って呼ぶね♪～
source:
The game features the bratty niece Yuzuki, who manipulates her uncle—a school judo instructor—to reveal his darker, more animalistic side.
